original_card.question: Does a named residual packing task have meaningful uncovered headroom after its exact fixed-inventory ceiling?
methods: Check a fixed-inventory ceiling and source equivalence before any explicitly bounded residual search.
Price a genuinely changed word/interface under a newly applicable model.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Check live overlap and exact model/source binding first. Distinguish a chronological construction from a pooled optimum. State the applicable fixed-inventory ceiling and remaining headroom; changed words or interfaces require a new fully charged model. Do not launch a residual search without an explicit scope and time cap.

first_step.inspect: Read #4091 fixed-word pooled ceiling and #4088 later 1090-call literal fill. Bind the unchanged local invoices/capacities/stock before transferring the ceiling; its earlier 1080-call residual-bin recipe is historical.
first_step.scope: Source-binding orientation only; no scientific replay, theorem acceptance or supplier admission. Budget any heavy replay separately.

original_card.first_experiment: Default to a bounded headroom/source-equivalence check. Only start residual search with an explicit unclaimed domain, time cap and reason the tiny remaining gain matters. Otherwise hand off or select a changed-word mechanism. A changed word or interface needs a fresh cost model, not the old ceiling. Stop at the fixed-inventory cap; do not extend by new random seeds.
original_card.bottleneck_link: An actual paid-profile gain can improve the frontier up to the other supplier cap.
allowed_variations: One bounded residual packing instance or exact relaxation.
If the coverage law, template or guard changes, derive an applicable fully charged replacement bound instead of applying the incumbent ceiling outside its scope.
scope_change_triggers: Rerunning an existing search with only a different seed as a separate mathematical contribution.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4091: pooled optimum at one-third staging for pinned fixed words; not a chronological fill.
existing_checks.remaining: Independent scope/source check; any residual optimization is explicitly bounded and optional.

existing_checks.scope: PR #4088: later 1090-call literal fill improves the earlier 1080-call witness.
existing_checks.remaining: Complete admission remains separate; old residual-bin instructions must not be copied blindly.

actual_scope: Does the h = 8 BIT word family of PR555/PR589 (all admissible puncture sets and all receiver choices of PR589's set) contain a word with a better local paid profile, and does any gain survive on the current compact436 / #4760 BIT supplier?
scope_change_reason: The residual task is the generator choice space behind PR589's word (closed #4633's unsourced '292 other h = 8 words'), not a pooled packing ceiling; changed words are priced under the current p16 invoice with fresh tuner passes, and transfer to #4760 is checked by construction where possible and otherwise only estimated.
bottleneck_link: Side result: no new kappa. Closes the h = 8 BIT word family behind PR589 as a source of BIT gain on the current supplier (complex still binds the selected kappa).
stop_rule: Stop after the complete puncture-set and receiver census, tuning of the leading receiver profiles, and the transfer check onto #4760's compact436 supplier; do not port the full compact436 lineage for a gain below the 0.1% gate.
evidence: verify.py tables checks the committed census tables (all 17,478 admissible sets, 200x31 receiver draws, all 19,683 receivers of PR589's set) against the enumeration, the invoice root of every stored profile and the mass identity, and rebuilds six rows; verify.py words rebuilds PR589 and the receiver variants from PR555's frozen parameters, prices them by exact root brackets, runs xcheck_p, and checks the collision with the compact436 lineage and the stacking estimate; test_verify.py has eight rejecting controls.
